extensionDescription.message: A modern, beautiful, and secure Org-mode document viewer for Chrome. Preview .org files in-place or via drag-and-drop.

largeFileWarning.message: This file is larger than 5MB. Automatic rendering was paused to preserve performance.

dropzoneSubtitle.message: or browse from computer, or paste Org text below

optionsWebAccessDesc.message: Automatically render .org files when visiting web URLs (requires optional permission)

optionsFileAccessGranted.message: Enabled (local file:///*.org files will be rendered)

optionsFileAccessMissing.message: Disabled (Click to enable 'Allow access to file URLs')

welcomeStep1Desc.message: Chrome requires manual permission for extensions to read local file:/// URLs. To view your local .org notes:

welcomeStep1Tip.message: Scroll down and toggle ON 'Allow access to file URLs'.

welcomeStep2Desc.message: Open any .org file directly in Chrome, or drag and drop it into the Org Viewer tab.

optionsLanguageDesc.message: Choose the display language for Org Viewer.

statusEnabled.message: Status: Enabled. Local file:///*.org files will be rendered.

statusDisabled.message: Status: Disabled. Click Manage Permission to enable 'Allow access to file URLs'.
